description: This beautiful trail from Strachur takes you through the forest, between mountains, and past Curra Lochain to the Sruth Ban Falls. Starting in Strachur next to Loch Fyne you head east through the forest for a distance of just over 6 miles to reach the picturesque falls. You can continue your walking by heading east to visit Lochgoilhead and Loch Goil and the Argyll Forest Park. Loch Fyne and Tarbert Castle can be found just to the west while the long distance Cowal Way also runs through the area.
